feeds.title: Music Therapy Connections
feeds.description: Music Therapy Connections, LLC was established in 2007 by Rachel Rambach. In 2014, Katey Kamerad joined forces with Rachel and became co-owner. Located in central Illinois, services are provided to children & young adults of all ages and levels of development. These services include individual and group music therapy, voice/piano/guitar lessons, and early childhood music classes.

feeds.title: Music Therapy Ed
feeds.description: We teach you how to use music to make a positive change. We are here to help you improve service to your clients, grow in your practice, feel satisfied in your career, and reach all of your professional goals by providing high-quality music therapy continuing education.

feeds.title: Roman Music Therapy Services Blog
feeds.description: Roman Music Therapy Services provides individual and group music therapy services in the Greater Boston area. Using music to help our clients reach their full potential, from birth to end of life care. We use music to create solutions, build community and enhance life!

feeds.title: Heart and Harmony Music Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Featuring the benefits of music therapy, DIY music therapy instruments, therapy struggles, and session ideas. Heart and Harmony is a team of like-minded therapists who are committed to providing high-quality music therapy services to the Dallas Fort Worth community.

feeds.title: Healing Sounds Music Therapy
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Stephanie, and I'm the owner/music therapist behind Healing Sounds Music Therapy. I can't promise that I'll have all the answers to your questions or problems. However, I promise that I'll do my very best to help you in a non-judgemental and accepting way. We will work together as a team in accomplishing your goals.

feeds.title: Wholesome Harmonies Blog
feeds.description: Amy Kalas Buser established Wholesome Harmonies, LLC in 2006 with a mission to provide high-quality music therapy services to individuals with autism and related disabilities. It is dedicated to sharing their passion for music therapy. It is a leading provider of music therapy services in South Florida, Pennsylvania, Maryland, and DC. They offer a variety of services, including individual and group music therapy, and traditional and adapted lessons on guitar, piano, ukulele, voice, and drums.

feeds.title: Creative Therapy Umbrella
feeds.description: The Creative Therapy Umbrella was created in hopes of providing resources and inspiration to therapists working with children and their families. Part of my motivation to make this blog is to support interns, entry-level professionals, and professionals looking for more support when working with children in all settings. Reach out and let me know what you feel would be helpful for you as you continue your therapy journey!

feeds.title: New England Region of the American Music Therapy Association Blog
feeds.description: We are composed of AMTA members. The purpose of our organization is to advance the aims, purposes, and goals of the American Music Therapy Association (AMTA) within a regional organization. This page is for sharing information relative to music therapy and happenings in the New England Region.

feeds.title: Storytelling Music Blog
feeds.description: I've used music as a form of therapy most of my life, as it has helped me cope with various situations in my life; whether I wanted to get motivation, feel comforted, reminisce, or if I just want to think positively about something going on in my mind.

feeds.title: Metro Music Makers Blog
feeds.description: Metro Music Makers provides convenient, individualized, in-home music lessons and music therapy services in the Metro Atlanta area. The exceptional learning experience we offer our students through one-on-one music instruction and priceless performance opportunities enables our students to achieve confidence in expressing themselves through music.

feeds.title: Harmony Garden Music Therapy
feeds.description: Jaime received her Bachelors Degree in Music Therapy from Michigan State University. She completed her music therapy internship at the Center for Discovery in Harris, NY. HGMTS has been providing music therapy and early childhood music (Harmony Garden Sprouts) in Jackson ever since.

feeds.title: Music Heals Blog
feeds.description: We are a group of music enthusiasts and music lovers who have come together to help raise awareness of the healing powers of music. We increase access to music therapy for patients in children's hospitals, senior's centres, palliative care, AIDS & HIV programs, at-risk youth, habilitation, and bereavement support.

feeds.title: iCalmPet Blog
feeds.description: Clinically-tested calming music for anxious dogs and cats. Bioacoustically-designed for calming, separation anxiety, and training dogs & puppies.

feeds.title: sona blog
feeds.description: Experience the therapeutic power of music with Sona - a sleep music app. Explore neuroscience-based calming music for anxiety and stress on the Sona app. Find amazingly effective tips and insights to relieve anxiety naturally along with other vital information on this blog.

feeds.title: The Musical Autist Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to provide equal rights to the fine arts and to create platforms for self advocacy, by giving credentialed music therapists the tools and resources they need to facilitate Sensory Friendly Concerts in their own local communities.

feeds.title: Music To Grow On Blog
feeds.description: A compilation of resources written by board-certified music therapists on a variety of topics, including adaptive lessons, intellectual and developmental disabilities, making music, session planning, special education, and mental health. Music To Grow On offers music therapy services for individuals with disabilities.

feeds.title: Pediatric Music Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Pediatric Music Therapy is a collaborative community to support pediatric music therapists and making the medical world feel more accessible.

feeds.title: I'm a Music Therapist Blog
feeds.description: I'm a Music Therapist is written by Brea Murakami, MM, MT-BC. She is a board-certified music therapist and adjunct faculty member at Pacific University in Oregon. Brea is interested in how music can positively impact emotion and memory and in connecting the science of music cognition to the clinical practice of music therapy.

feeds.title: The Groovy Garfoose Blog
feeds.description: Whether working with individuals or groups, therapists at the Groovy Garfoose meet individuals where they are with music experiences that motivate, inspire and support growth and achievement in every area of life. The GG Blog is chock-full of music therapy videos, songs, app review and session ideas. Read on for tips and tricks for use at home or in your own therapy practice.

feeds.title: ET Music Therapy
feeds.description: ET Music Therapy is based on one simple principle: Music is one of the most motivating & effective mediums for building strong connections with individuals with special needs.

feeds.title: Music Blooms Music Therapy Blog
feeds.description: The mission of Music Blooms Music Therapy, LLC is to provide the highest quality of music therapy services to our clients while advancing the profession of music therapy through service delivery, education and advocacy.

feeds.title: music-therapy-joy Blog
feeds.description: Patina is a board certified music therapist. She has experience in behavioral health and home-health, but it was her experience in special education where her desire to resource other music therapists was realized. Her role of providing support to new music therapists in special education settings led her to create Music Therapy Joy.

feeds.title: Piedmont Music Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Piedmont Music Therapy, LLC is a private practice that provides music therapy treatment for children through older adults South Charlotte Clinic and on site at area schools, centers and residential programs.

feeds.title: Bay Area Music Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Bay Area Music Therapy is an organization dedicated to providing you with the highest quality integrative music therapy services. Our well-trained music therapists and adjunct providers can address the emotional, physical, psychological and social needs of you, your loved ones, or your community.

feeds.title: Next Time Won't You Sing With Me?
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Katy Hutchings, MM, MA, MT-BC. I am a board certified music therapist. On my blog find Adventures in Early Childhood Music Therapy.

feeds.title: More with Music
feeds.description: My name is Amanda Ellis and I am a board-certified music therapist. This site is for parents, teachers & music therapists who are searching for songs and ideas to help teach children of all ages.

feeds.title: Music Therapy Maven
feeds.description: My name is Kimberly Sena Moore. I am a board certified music therapist, a professor in the Frost School of Music, and an advisor on legislative and policy issues for Certification Board for Music Therapists. Explore this site for information on music therapy, developing a therapy practice, and my journey as a working woman in academia who moonlights as a full-time mommy.

feeds.title: Music Therapy Research Blog
feeds.description: MTRB was created for the working music therapy clinician in order to help with the goal of maintaining evidence-based practice. The purpose of this blog is to provide a resource for the music therapy clinician where you can find information on current research, ways to generalize findings into practice, and tips about maintaining an evidence-based practice.

feeds.title: a suite sound Blog
feeds.description: As a board-certified music therapist and an alumni of the Music Therapy Program at Texas Woman's University, my goal is to use this blog to advocate for music therapy and to share the many lessons I learn as a musician and music therapist.

feeds.title: Listen & Learn Music - Helping children grow and thrive through music Blog
feeds.description: Listen & Learn Music is the home of over 200 music therapy songs and early childhood music resources by board-certified music therapist Rachel Rambach. Here she shares her original songs and thoughts on music therapy, motherhood, and business ownership.

feeds.title: Perfect Harmony Health Blog
feeds.description: The George Center for Music Therapy is committed to providing a creative approach to therapy, by fostering an environment of fun and achievement. Our programs include adaptive music lessons, NICU services, early intervention, Bloom in Music (children's developmental community music program), mental health support, developmental delay, memory care, and therapeutic support of individualized goals.

feeds.title: JB Music Therapy Blog
feeds.description: JBMT is a team of Accredited Music Therapists (MTAs) who design treatment plans for people of all ages to foster change: boost mood, decrease stress, improve speech after injury, increase focus, develop learning, lessen anxiety, and recover lost memories.

feeds.title: Peterson Family Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Peterson Family Foundation creates and sustains music therapy programs across the globe. Our primary mission is to seek out and support experts and institutions dedicated to enhancing and improving the lives of people afflicted by mesothelioma, pediatric diabetes and pediatric leukemia.

feeds.title: Music Therapy Source Blog
feeds.description: Music Therapy Source is a blog and web resource for music therapists and those interested in the field of music therapy. Content on Music Therapy Source is managed by Matt Logan, MA, MT-BC. Matt is a practicing music therapist in Oakland, California.

feeds.title: World Federation of Music Therapy
feeds.description: The World Federation of Music Therapy (WFMT) is an international nonprofit organization bringing together music therapy associations and individuals interested in developing and promoting music therapy globally through the exchange of information, collaboration among professionals, and actions.

feeds.title: Music Therapy Time Blog
feeds.description: One therapist's opinion about music, the brain, and life.Erin Seibert is a music therapist seeking to better understand herself and others through the use of music and the practice of everyday perception and regard.

feeds.title: Metro Music Therapy
feeds.description: We envision a day when all of our clients will be given the opportunity to grow, thrive and heal through their involvement in music therapy services. Our mission is to offer the most current and innovative music therapy and recreation therapy practices to help our patients and clients achieve their therapeutic goals through the use of musical and recreational interventions.
